details: Owner of two RT-950 Pros: the one programmed today (likely Web Programmer; desktop failed at port open, w-20261120-8265) beeps on PTT and does not transmit; the unprogrammed one is fine. Experimental write sends the full CPS block set, settings included. Candidates: TX off on the channel, TX outside the radio's TX range (owner's IC-F60V channels are 450-469 MHz commercial), busy lock, or a settings block changed by the write. Need: tool used, channel/frequency, whether any channel transmits, the pre-write backup and a fresh read.
summary: After a write, radio beeps on PTT and will not transmit
